title: Temporal-difference laboratory
description: Watch TD(0), SARSA, n-step SARSA, and Q-learning update a shared Grid World from one realised transition at a time.
ready: Ready. Advance a transition or run a finite episode budget.
paused: Paused. The current snapshot is preserved.
exhausted: The configured episode budget is exhausted.
clickCell: Select a state to inspect its backup
noTrace: Advance once to reveal a transition.
auditModelFree: uses realised samples, not a transition table
auditTarget: target and error are visible for each update

errors.temporal_difference_discount_range: Discount γ must be finite and in [0, 1].
errors.temporal_difference_slip_range: Wind probability must be finite and in [0, 1].
errors.temporal_difference_epsilon_range: Exploration ε must be finite and in [0, 1].
errors.temporal_difference_alpha_range: Learning rate α must be finite and in (0, 1].
errors.temporal_difference_n_step_range: The n-step horizon must be an integer from 1 through 100.
errors.temporal_difference_max_episodes_range: The episode budget must be an integer from 1 through 100,000.
errors.temporal_difference_max_steps_range: The episode step cap must be an integer from 1 through 100.
errors.temporal_difference_reward_range: Each reward must be finite with magnitude at most 1,000,000.
errors.temporal_difference_worker: The temporal-difference engine reported an internal error.
errors.worker_error: The temporal-difference Worker reported an internal error.
